effect: Both local control and the independent mechanical release work on the same fixture, completing the demonstration and the chapter.
reaction: Testing genuinely separate fallback mechanisms was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the status report from June's observation was most worthwhile: it showed both when the door was seen open and that the sensor was unavailable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the controller to the keyed door felt somewhat repetitive after both entry methods had already been demonstrated separately.

surprise.text: The controller-and-latch combination completed the readiness goal before the entry and status goal; it also made clear that one working controller does not mean the neighborhood is connected.

arbitrary.text: Completing the readiness goal when testing the latch felt a little abrupt, since the result did not explain how the assistant and migration evidence were kept ready.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the modest local controller and the migration evidence are extended into a neighborhood response, though the offered compatible combinations made the individual choices fairly straightforward.
